jsonSchema.name: nostr event tagging
jsonSchema.title: Nostr Event Tagging
jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema for the concept of nostr event taggings. Permissive: event-tagging assertions carry empty content (discovery runs off tags), so no content payload is required.

nostrEventTag.name: nostr event tagging
nostrEventTag.title: Nostr Event Tagging
nostrEventTag.description: Optional. Documents the (forward-compat) shape of an event-tagging assertion's payload; not required.

target.name: target
target.title: Target
target.description: The tagged event, as an event id (mirrors the e tag) or an addressable coordinate <kind>:<author>:<d> (mirrors the a tag).

polarity.name: polarity
polarity.title: Polarity
polarity.description: 1 = applied, -1 = disputed; absent = applied. Mirrors the event's polarity tag.
